Keep only clutch time

Source: R/games.R
clutch_time.Rd

Events in the last minutes of the fourth quarter or overtime with the score within margin points (the NBA's definition: last 5 minutes, within 5). Feed the result to box_score() or on_off().

Usage

clutch_time(pbp, minutes = 5, margin = 5)

Arguments

pbp

Play-by-play in the ggbasket layout (see pbp), one or more games.

minutes, margin

Window and score difference.
